focus.name: scene-palette-banks
focus.purpose: Bound the fixed blank and scene-transition palette sources consumed by the shared palette transition helper.

consumer.name: Render_RunPaletteTransitionFrom
consumer.source_contract: Publishes A0, A0+0x20, A0+0x40, and A0+0x60 as four 16-word palette bands; Render_ApplyPaletteStep converges 0x40 words from the source.

evidence: The shared transition entry publishes four 0x20-byte source bands.
The palette convergence loop consumes exactly 0x40 words per source.
Both source pointers are direct ROM addresses from named scene/render callers.
limitations: The intervening four-band palette bank is separate from both directly consumed sources and has no recovered consumer.
Other 16-word palette upload sources elsewhere in the ROM remain separate records.
